verdicts.reason: Both drop the white heart/cross shape that framed the copy and shrink the photo to a tiny thumbnail on the left. The headline is small, thin and stacked in three short lines, which wastes the wide banner format. A pushes the copy to the far right edge, leaving a huge dead gap between photo and text so the two halves feel disconnected. B centres the copy closer to the photo, so it reads slightly more as one design, but the right third is still empty and nothing is prominent enough.
